title: IKEA Tradfri Remote Battery Drain
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tradfri:device device_class=remote
| sort 0 device _time
| streamstats current=f last(battery_pct) as prev_battery_pct by device
| eval battery_drop=prev_battery_pct-battery_pct
| stats sum(battery_drop) as total_battery_drop by device
| where total_battery_drop>10
| sort - total_battery_drop
description: Uses IKEA Tradfri remote reports telemetry to monitor which remotes are losing battery faster than expected in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for controls that will become flaky sooner than they should, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest IKEA Tradfri remote reports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Remote table of accumulated battery drop.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which remotes are losing battery faster than expected so you can spot controls that will become flaky sooner than they should before it becomes annoying.
